evidence.excerpt: The invention relates to a computerised method for assigning fabric rolls of heterogeneous remaining lengths to multi-layer cutting spreads in garment and textile production. The method accepts as input a list of available roll lengths, required spread lengths, and layer counts per cutting plan, and outputs a roll-to-spread assignment minimising total tail-end waste. The core procedure applies a Lagrangian relaxation of a set-covering formulation solved iteratively with subgradient updates. The system interfaces with standard inventory management data exports and outputs assignments in a format compatible with common spreading machine control software. Granted by the Intellectual Property Office of Serbia.
